You are free to use, study, modify, and distribute ClaudeSec under the terms of the AGPL.
The full license text is in the [`LICENSE`](../LICENSE) file at the root of this repository.

### Network-use copyleft (the key AGPL requirement)

The AGPL extends the GPL's copyleft to cover network use. If you modify ClaudeSec and run
your modified version as a network service — for example, as a hosted SaaS dashboard
accessible to other users — you must make the complete corresponding source code of your
modified version available to those users under the AGPL.

Purely internal deployment — where only members of your own organization access it over
your own network — is generally considered lower-risk, but AGPL §13 turns on remote
network interaction, so seek legal advice for your specific situation.

## Commercial License

A **commercial license** is available for organizations that cannot comply with the AGPL —
for example, those wishing to embed ClaudeSec in a proprietary product, distribute it as
part of a closed-source offering, or use it in a SaaS product without releasing their
source code under the AGPL.

To inquire about a commercial license, open a GitHub issue or contact the maintainers
through the project's GitHub repository.
